rca of the issue: Original bug: Production Dashboard showed 'Saison 13' because the previous logic (plus grande saison non-verrouillée + 1) relied on S13 being locked, which is not the case on Production. Fix (verified): combined logic max(annee_civile - 2012, plus_grande_saison_non_verrouillee_via_config) capped at 20. This makes detection independent of lock state on Production. Confirmed in 3 scenarios: (a) all S1-13 locked → 14, (b) S13 unlocked → 14, (c) none locked → 14.
